title: GoHighLevel Expert Needed for a Small CRM & Automation Task

facts: Post: small task inside the client's GHL account, may involve a workflow, CRM pipeline, lead capture form, automation, email/SMS follow-up, appointment booking or funnel element.
Post lists tags, custom fields, opportunities, triggers and workflow actions, A2P / SMS setup.
Post: someone who can complete the task correctly without extensive supervision.
No client name, business or industry in the post. Sample business and people are invented.

close.title: Measure each request
close.caption: We'd agree the starting numbers, then track reply speed, booked calls, and requests still waiting.

metrics.name: Time to first reply
metrics.definition: Median time from the request tag being added to the first text or email sent to that contact, measured over an agreed period.

metrics.name: Booked calls per 100 requests
metrics.aim: Book more calls from the same requests
metrics.definition: Contacts whose opportunity reaches Call booked, divided by all tagged requests in the same period, multiplied by 100. Each contact counts once.

metrics.name: Requests with no next step
metrics.definition: Open opportunities in New request that have no message sent and no assigned owner after one business day, counted at the end of each week.

close.beat: I'd track how fast new requests hear back, how many book a call, and how many are still waiting, starting from your current numbers. Worth a quick 15-minute call? Reply here and I'll send times.

scenes.title: The workflow checks for SMS consent before it texts anyone.
scenes.caption: The quote-request tag starts it, and the consent answer decides between a text and an email.
scenes.beat: When the form adds the quote-request tag, this workflow starts. It creates the opportunity and assigns Devon. Then it checks whether Talia agreed to texts. She did, so she gets a text and Devon gets an alert. Without consent, the same request gets an email instead.
details: If/Else: SMS consent on file? Yes sends a text, No sends an email
